name: view_every_tower_form
description: Every tower form has its view (design 3.4 and 3.7): the Lamplighter's three bases and six branches and the Lookout's, each standing as its own model from Game.TOWERS with its turning head seated where it has one; a fork swaps the model and the head.

steps.assert: scene.tower_at(Vector2i(6, 3)).form == 'arrow' and scene.tower_at(Vector2i(6, 3))._base.scene_file_path == Game.TOWERS['arrow'].model and scene.tower_at(Vector2i(6, 3))._head == null
steps.msg: the arrow stands as its own model, no head
